# <span class="text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100">Stages 1,001-1,200</span>

Stage 1,001 freezes the final variable: equipment drop chance settles at 0.118% and holds for every remaining stage. From this point on the stage table is genuinely one-dimensional - the same drop tier, the same dice, the same diamonds, with health and attack multiplying steadily underneath and only wave size still shuffling between four and eighteen monsters.

Rewards do keep climbing, but not smoothly. Gold and EXP per kill sawtooth within each twenty-stage chapter rather than rising monotonically, so the best farming stage in a region is rarely its last one. The tables below are worth actually reading for that reason.
